# Drug and Alcohol Abuse Prevention Training for Construction Workers

> 2-hour online awareness training for construction workers on drug and alcohol misuse, the science of addiction, jobsite impairment risks and prevention. Supports OSHA General Duty Clause expectations and Drug-Free Workplace Program requirements. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 2 hours; 4 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $49.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years
- Regulatory context: no specific OSHA substance abuse standard; the General Duty Clause, Section 5(a)(1) of the OSH Act, requires a workplace free from recognized hazards

## Lessons
1. Problems of Drugs and Alcohol (substance use disorder, contributing factors, common substances, effects)
2. Understanding the Science of Addiction (dopamine pathways, decision-making, chronic disease, treatability)
3. Impact of Drugs and Alcohol in the Construction Industry (accidents, injuries, productivity, employer and worker responsibilities)
4. Prevention and Control of Drugs and Alcohol Dependency (education, drug-free workplace policies, support programs)

## Who should take it
Construction workers in safety-sensitive jobsite roles; crews on projects requiring a Drug-Free Workplace Program; employers and supervisors building a safety culture.
